caption: The video captures a close view of a small metal saucepan with a black handle resting on a lit gas burner, its blue flame flickering beneath the pan on a white stovetop. A person's two hands enter the frame, one gripping the pan's handle at the right while the other holds a black silicone spatula marked with a small red logo. The spatula head works through a partly set yellow egg mixture showing soft curds suspended in liquid. The spatula moves in a continuous stirring and folding motion, working mainly through the center of the pan and displacing the curds. The hand on the spatula makes small positional adjustments, tilting the handle slightly, while the hand on the pan handle remains steady. A pale marble-look countertop fills the background beside an unused burner grate to the left. The egg mixture stays semi-liquid and in motion, the stirring process ongoing.
